final: WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(product_quantity) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND TRIM(product_quantity) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(TRIM(product_quantity) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, CAST(units AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_units), scored AS (SELECT units, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(units) AS combined_units, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM scored WHERE share > avg_share
